title: Basis Expansions for Regression Modeling
text: bases provides various basis expansions flexible regression modeling, including: random Fourier features (?b_rff) exact kernel / Gaussian process feature maps (?b_ker) Bayesian additive regression trees (BART) prior features (?b_bart) neural network features (?b_nn) graph Fourier features (?b_gff) random convolutional image features (?b_conv) helpful interface n-way interactions (?b_inter) provided functions may used within modeling formula, allowing use kernel methods basis expansions modeling functions otherwise support . Along basis expansions, number kernel functions (?kernels) also provided, support kernel arithmetic form new kernels. Basic ridge regression functionality (?ridge) included well. Finally, package provides two ways interfacing complex modeling workflows: Integration mgcv, basis expansions can used smooth terms within s(). enables fitting different levels penalization different basis expansions. recipes-friendly interface, basis expansions can combined transformations used within tidymodels framework.

title: Tensor-product Sobolev space basis — b_tpsob
text: Generates features tensor-product Sobolev space basis estimating functions Sobolev space dominating mixed derivatives. Basis functions form $$     \psi_{\mathbf{j}}(\mathbf{x}) = \prod_{k=1}^d \psi_{j_k}(x_k), $$ $$      \phi_1(x) = 1 \quad\text{}\quad      \phi_j(x) = \sqrt{2}\cos(\pi (j-1) x). $$ multi-indices \(\mathbf{j}\) generated specific order maximize statistical efficiency. inputs standardized lie unit hypercube \([0, 1]^d\).
